Authentication is handled via the Vitalis-DC01 domain controller. If the primary tunnel fails, technicians should failover to the secondary Cisco ASA node (v-asa-ext-02.vitalis.com) using the shared certificate stored in the /dev/certs/internal/ directory...
investigation_notes.Description: An external document indexed by TI-Monitor-Scribd contains internal Vitalis Healthcare infrastructure details including an internal VPN gateway IP (10.45.2.112), a domain controller reference (Vitalis-DC01), and paths to stored certificates. The exposed content represents sensitive configuration data that could be used to map internal network topology or facilitate credential or certificate-based attacks. This alert is considered HP because disclosure of internal addressing, authentication infrastructure, and certificate locations materially increases risk and should be escalated for further investigation.
